evidence: Source review against native build 1: backend snapshots and usage responses retain their field shapes, including the UsageBackend fields decoded by UsageModels.swift. The backend update endpoint now requires owner authority; the native app has no caller of this endpoint and sends no agent actor headers. Conversation wire contracts, executor protocol, iOS build middleware, and native draft/outbox paths are unchanged. CLI selection and sealed package validation change host behavior only. Focused HTTP tests prove owner update acceptance and agent refusal before any updater runs. This review preserves the existing build floor for retained native features. No signed-device, TestFlight, reconnect, or draft-survival checks ran for this ticket.
